units.source_text: 出现在我眼前的，是一个闭着双目欢迎我的六十开外的女人，地挂着一张没有化妆的、被太阳晒得过黑的脸。

en.t: What appeared before my eyes was a woman past sixty who welcomed me with both eyes closed, her unmade-up face hanging there, darkened too much by the sun.

units.source_text: 我的亢奋一点都没有消失。

en.t: My excitement had not faded in the slightest.

units.source_text: 于是，丑恶剧发展到了高峰，我不知不觉地接受了诱惑……

en.t: And so the ugly drama reached its climax, and without realizing it I gave in to the temptation...
